scope: Real Hono/SQLite API acceptance; not UI acceptance

expectedPaper.method: Independent Python Decimal, prescribed transactions only; no production totals helpers, API responses or browser lookups used.

trialBalance.chartPolicy: Separate GST input asset and output liability, operating costs grouped. Map account roles using static chart setup before reading reports.

bankReconciliation.condition: All five statement movements match existing economic postings. No artificial adjustment or duplicate income/expense may force a zero.

controls.reconciliation: Technical import/classification reversal entries may exist but must have no net effect on frozen report or source amounts. Do not require exactly 11 total rows after reconciliation.

expectedPaper.openingPolicy: Opening balances as at 2026-09-30, brought forward to 1 October. This is not an October capital contribution.
